preconditions.description: The number of vertices (n) and special offers (m) must be within the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**12 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex value a_i must be a positive integer up to 10^12.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= w <= 10**12 and x != y for x, y, w in offers)
preconditions.description: Each special offer must have valid vertex indices (x, y) and cost (w), with x ≠ y.

postconditions.description: The output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost to connect the graph.
The output must equal the minimum cost to connect all vertices in the graph, considering both standard and special offer edge costs.
